What are the advantages and disadvantages of using beta vs standard deviation in valuation?
questions_and_answers.answer: Beta and standard deviation measure different things. Beta shows the extent the stock moves relative to the direction of the market. Standard deviation shows how the stock return varies from expected value, which can result from both market and non-market reasons. Conventional beta takes on institutional investor's perspective, whose portfolio is diversified, and so only accounts for systematic risks and better suited to determine base discount rate before adding other premiums for specific risks. Alternatively, if the buyer is not diversified, total beta (which incorporates standard deviation concept) can also be used.
